title: Indonesian Authorities Crack Down on Controversial Papua Documentary
detail: Indonesian authorities have moved to suppress a controversial documentary about Papua, underscoring persistent press freedom concerns and political censorship tensions surrounding the restive eastern province. The crackdown highlights ongoing efforts by Jakarta to control narratives about Papua, where an armed independence movement has long clashed with security forces and journalists face restrictions on independent reporting. Papua remains one of the most restricted regions for media access in Southeast Asia, with international journalists routinely denied entry permits.

media.caption: Indonesian authorities crack down on Papua documentary amid press freedom concerns
